author: The Q
description:
The new Anker soundcore Liberty 5 Pro and Liberty 5 Pro Max hold the Guinness World Record for call clarity in noisy environments, so I wanted to test them somewhere much more realistic than a quiet studio.

From cafés and supermarkets to construction sites and metro stations, I wanted to see how they actually perform when real life gets loud. After using them for a while, I was genuinely impressed by how consistently clear the calls stayed, even in places where most earbuds usually struggle.

For everyday calls, music, ANC, and commuting, the Liberty 5 Pro already feels incredibly complete. If your day is packed with meetings and productivity, the Liberty 5 Pro Max adds some genuinely useful features that I ended up using much more than I expected.
